evidence: Pathfinder resolved 3 circular contigs instead of 1, all individually normal-sized (135-150kb) with complete/near-complete standard land-plant chloroplast gene sets (79-80/80 genes each, own IR duplication). Outside the universally-conserved IR, pairwise minimap2 alignment between the three is only 20-40% fragmented identity (not the same genome via alternate paths). Path-weight field in ctg.fasta headers shows kept contig at ~23-27x the weight of the other two, consistent with cross-contamination (e.g. barcode bleed from another sample) at much lower abundance than the real genome - same failure mode already documented for Carduus_nutans/Cratoneuron_filicinum/Isopterygiella_pulchella/Malus_domestica (analysis/qc_basic_stats/src/05_qc_summary.py), except Pathfinder there left the contaminant subgraph unresolved so it never reached ctg.fasta.
action: Canonical pltd.ctg.fasta and pltd.ctg.bed rewritten to contain only the dominant contig; original 3-contig versions preserved alongside as *.full_pre_curation.{fasta,bed}. pltd.gfa/pltd.bed/annot_pltd.txt left untouched (still reflect the full graph, same as the four precedent species).
